DigiCert True Business ID

A DigiCert-powered TLS/SSL certificate that protects your website, brand and visitors

GeoTrust DV SSL

GeoTrust® DV Certificates are the fastest way to get the basic protection required for your website to display as secure. DV stands for domain validation—you use an automated process to prove ownership of your domain name, allowing for fast certificate issuance.

Ideal for organizations that don't need the peace of mind provided by the high-assurance validation processes required for OV and EV certificates.

  • Domain ownership validation
  • GeoTrust Powered by DigiCert Site seal 
  • Priority validation
  • 9-16 authentication checks 

GeoTrust True Business ID

GeoTrust True Business ID® offers enhanced validation processes, ensuring your business identity is thoroughly verified and protected. Plus, True Business ID certificates include the GeoTrust Site Seal, giving visitors confidence in your site’s authenticity.

GeoTrust True Business ID certificates offer the best value for leveling up trust in your organization’s online presence. 

  • Organization validation
  • GeoTrust Powered by DigiCert Site seal 
  • Priority validation
  • 9-16 authentication checks 

GeoTrust True Business ID with EV

GeoTrust TrueBusiness ID® offers enhanced validation processes, ensuring that your business identity is thoroughly verified and protected. Plus, TrueBusiness ID Certificates include the GeoTrust Site Seal to give website visitors confidence in the authenticity of your website.

GeoTrust TrustBusiness ID Certificates provide the best value for leveling up trust in your organization's online presence.

  • Extensive company validation to protect your brand
  • GeoTrust Powered by DigiCert Site seal 
  • Priority validation
  • 9-16 authentication checks

CONTACT US

Features

Whether you’re a growing company in need of business-level authentication or an established organization with a bustling e-commerce site, a GeoTrust True Business ID TLS/SSL certificate will give you and your visitors the protection they deserve.

Continuous Protection 

Prevent expensive lapses, forecast your budget more accurately and support your certificate lifecycle automation goals.

Compatibility with all Major Browsers 

Choose a TLS/SSL certificate that’s recognized by all major browsers and trusted worldwide, earning user trust and ensuring where your site is accessed from doesn’t impact its security.

Customizable Certificate Lifespans 

Customize your certificate lifespans to meet regional or organizational standards.  

Supports Extended Validation

Choose an EV certificate at purchase or during your next renewal to give your website the highest level of identity validation.

Specifications

  • X.509 format Certificate meets software & industry standards
  • Symmetric 256-bit encryption
  • Unlimited server licensing
  • Support 2048-bit public key encryption
  • Free reissues and replacement for the lifetime of the certificate

Frequently Asked Questions


An OV certificate provides the base level of identity validation, while an EV certificate adds extra layers of verification. EV certificates are ideal for e-commerce, enterprise use, and organizations who desire the highest level of authentication.  


During the validation process, we confirm your organization’s identity before issuing a certificate for your domain. Priority validation speeds up the process by assigning you a dedicated validation specialist. The exact timing will depend on the level of validation required for your certificate, but once we have the documentation we need, your certificate will typically be issued in less than an hour.
